description: Controlled single-variable ablation study, axes 1-4. Each axis changes exactly one protocol component; all other components (data, hyperparameters, seeds, models) are held identical. Axis 5 (semantic alignment) is intentionally not executed -- see module docstring in benchmark/ablation_study.py for why.

1_split_strategy.source: matched split control, 8 models x 10 seeds x 2 splits

4_frozen_confirmation.caveat: oracle side uses target labels; non-deployable upper bound only

5_semantic_alignment.reason: no well-defined single-variable change; would require training a new model on a different feature space
